name: Sika AnchorFix®-3001
tagline: EPOXY HIGH PERFORMANCE CHEMICAL ANCHORING ADHESIVE
summary: Sika AnchorFix®-3001 is an epoxy resin based, 2-part, thixotropic, 1:1 mixing ratio, high performance anchoring adhesive. It is specifically designed for anchoring threaded rods and reinforcement bars in both cracked and un-cracked dry or damp concrete.
metaDescription: Sika AnchorFix®-3001 is an epoxy resin based, 2-part, thixotropic, 1:1 mixing ratio, high performance anchoring adhesive. It is specifically designed for anchoring threaded rods and reinforcement bars in both cracked and un-cracked dry or damp concrete.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +10 °C and +25 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: Service temperature
items.text:
Long term | -40 °C min. / +40 °C max.
Short term (1–2 hours) | +80 °C

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: Part A : Part B = 1 : 1 by volume

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Beware of condensation. Substrate temperature during application must be at least +3 °C above dew point.

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: Mortar and concrete must be at the required design strength. Substrate tensile / compressive strengths (concrete, masonry, natural stone) must be confirmed by testing. The anchor hole must always be clean, free from oil and grease etc. Loose particles must be removed from the holes. Threaded rods and rebar's must be cleaned thoroughly and free from dirt, oil, grease, corrosion products or any other substances and particles which could affect adhesion.

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
Preparing cartridge: 250 ml
1. Unscrew and remove the cap
2. Pull out the plug
3. Screw on the static mixer
4. Place the cartridge into the application gun ready for use
Preparing cartridge: 400, 600 & 1500 ml
1.Unscrew the cap
2. Pull out the red plug
3. Screw on the static mixer
4. Place the cartridge into the application gun ready for use
When the work is interrupted the static mixer nozzle can remain on the cartridge after the gun pressure has been released. If the resin has hardened in the nozzle when work is resumed, a new nozzle must be attached.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with Sika® Colma Cleaner immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.
